identity_check: Confirmed as UGX.AI (ugx.ai; legal entity UGX Systems Private Limited, Sector 34, Gurugram), the discrete-manufacturing shop-floor platform co-founded in 2023 by Abhishek Kumar, Ankur Singh, Ankit Agarwal and Prakhar Nigam. The company site (Industrial DataOps platform, Gurugram address, UGX Systems Pvt Ltd), Entrepreneur India (October 2025 seed), Venture Intelligence (which gives ugx.ai as the website) and Inc42's profile (linking ugx.ai, same legal name) describe the same business. Category set to 'adjacent' (not in the PROJECT_CONTEXT §7 seed list; candidate from a discovery search). UGX sells the plant data and MES layer to Indian discrete manufacturers (automotive and electronics): an edge gateway and protocol library for machine connectivity, MES functions (work orders, scheduling, traceability and material genealogy), vision-based quality inspection, and apps for predictive maintenance and machine observability. That covers the same plants and some of the same maintenance and quality problems as Utopian Autonomy, but no AI agents, copilot, chat or WhatsApp interface appear on its site, and it does not touch procurement, RFQ, BOM or engineering drawings. The discovery lead's 'agents' claim (YourStory, November 2025) could not be read (HTTP 403); if UGX ships plant-staff agents it should move to 'direct'.

Named customers come from the home page logo strip headed 'Trusted by Industry Leaders' (logo alt text); the nature of each relationship is not stated and no case studies are named.
The protocol count on the technology page is inconsistent ('500+' in the headline, '50+' in the stats).
Headcount (43) is from the Inc42 database profile only; the LinkedIn company page was not checked.

company.name: UGX.AI
company.description: Gurugram shop-floor data platform for discrete manufacturers: machine connectivity, MES and traceability, vision quality inspection and maintenance apps.

layer_detail: Plant data and execution layer: an industrial edge gateway and protocol library (Modbus, OPC-UA, Ethernet/IP, MQTT), a smart MES (work orders, scheduling, traceability and genealogy), vision-based quality inspection with statistical quality control, and out-of-box apps for predictive maintenance, machine observability and performance analytics, with ERP integrations (SAP, Oracle JD Edwards, Dynamics 365, Odoo, Zoho). Shop-floor tablets and barcode scanners; no agents, chat or WhatsApp channel seen.
product_summary: Industrial DataOps platform for discrete factories: an edge gateway and protocol library connect legacy and modern machines, feeding a smart MES for work orders, scheduling and material traceability, AI vision inspection for defects and dimensions, and apps for predictive maintenance, machine monitoring and live production dashboards, integrated with the plant's ERP.
